findings.claim: 10-K 列出主要競爭者（ADI、Broadcom、Credo、Marvell、MaxLinear、Microchip、NXP、Qorvo、Semtech、Skyworks、Sumitomo），並提到中國公司競爭加劇；亦點出客戶自研與低成本矽製程大廠為潛在替代
findings.excerpt: our significant competitors include, among others, ADI, Broadcom, Credo, Marvell, MaxLinear, Microchip, NXP, Qorvo, Semtech, Skyworks and Sumitomo as well as increased competition from Chinese companies.

findings.claim: 10-K 稱主要與客戶內部設計資源及其他高性能類比半導體供應商競爭，預期有新進入者，且未來有採低成本矽製程之大量製造商的替代技術競爭
findings.excerpt: We expect competition in our markets to change as new competitors enter these markets, existing competitors merge or form alliances and new technologies emerge. We believe that in the future there will be increased competition from companies utilizing alternative technologies, including high-volume manufacturers using low-cost silicon process technology.

findings.claim: 管理層稱 1.6T 為資料中心成長主要驅動，設計案進入量產；資料中心 FY26 成長基準由 35-40% 上調至 60% 以上
findings.source: MarketBeat / earnings call 摘要 (MACOM Q1 FY2026)

findings.claim: NXP 退出 5G RF 功率 GaN 為 MACOM 帶來份額機會，CEO 稱效益需一至兩年顯現
findings.source: Barchart MACOM Q1 earnings call analyst questions
